comparison.objective: Rotate a freely suspended humanoid upper body by half a turn and stop it gently; candidate breaks and recovers insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Momentum prediction, compliant catching, and braking of an 18.3 kg yawing load versus localized coaxial impact and small-fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Body within 10 degrees of 180 degrees and under 1 degree/s for one second, without blows or collision; no component fracture is desired.
comparison.reason: Tests momentum management of a suspended load; candidate deliberately causes four localized fractures under tight preservation constraints.
